name: Rising hook headline
summary: Eyebrow plus 1-3 display lines; letters rise out of masks, the last line can slam on a beat, clean exit upward. Already mid-rise on frame 0.

params.dot: boolean live dot before the eyebrow
params.accentLast: boolean, color the last line with --accent
params.cues: { start (can be negative; -0.4 puts frame 0 mid-rise), slam (last line), out (fully gone by) }
params.pace: { enter, exit, stagger, accent } overrides for the PACE timings (seconds)

changelog: v1 2026-09-26: extracted from the starter template hook

v2 2026-09-26: readable pacing. Transitions use PACE (entrances about 0.5 s, exits about 0.4 s, staggers about 0.14 s) with a `pace` override, cues.out means fully gone, and default cues and the demo leave time to read.
